items.title: Nepal’s historic loss and damage allocation falls short of its needs
items.blurb: The UN fund has provisionally set aside 21.6 million for Nepal after the Rasuwa disaster, marking a first while covering less than 0.5 percent of the country’s estimated $4.7 billion recovery and reconstruction needs.

items.title: Biratnagar take on Chitwan as Janakpur face Karnali in NPL double-header
items.blurb: Andre Russell and Angelo Mathews add star power to Biratnagar, while former champions Janakpur look to bounce back after a disappointing second season.

items.title: Restore hope for Bhotekoshi flood victims
items.blurb: The Bhotekoshi flood victims deserve answers; they cannot remain in uncertainty any longer.

items.title: Devoid of options, flood survivors return to damaged homes
items.blurb: The government has announced rent assistance, temporary shelters and new land for resettlement. Survivors and local officials say little of it has reached them.

items.title: Dust, bottlenecks slow Dashain traffic on BP Highway
items.blurb: Two years after floods damaged the highway, unfinished roads, narrow bridges and a surge in festive traffic are making the journey back to Kathmandu miserable.

items.title: Divers search for three missing after boat accident in Saptakoshi river
items.blurb: Seven divers and teams from Nepal’s Armed Police Force and Nepal Police have resumed the search for three people, including a seven-year-old boy, after a passenger boat suffered mechanical failure on Sunday.

items.title: Nepal to expand flood warning systems across six river basins
items.blurb: A new white paper outlines plans to lower water levels in four high-risk glacial lakes and strengthen disaster preparedness as climate change intensifies risks in the Himalayas.

items.title: Can a cricket league comfort a country in mourning?
items.blurb: Nepal Premier League cannot rebuild Rasuwa, but it can give a grieving nation somewhere to gather.
